page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically running on an Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is suitable for tasks such as web serving, batch processing, application servers, and lightweight compilation workloads.
